spec: §15 suite D (checker-computed bounds); §12.1 numerical claim: form interval enclosures of V^dagger U - I, bound the operator norm by the Frobenius upper bound, verify <= bound
derivation: Use the one-wire toggle action: U=V=X. All entries are exact integers and interval arithmetic represents them exactly at 64 bits. V†U-I = X*X-I = 0 entrywise, so the computed Frobenius upper bound is exactly 0. A Bell circuit would introduce irrational sqrt(2) enclosures and does not guarantee a zero computed interval bound.
